author: minh.nguyen
_comment: Author's note (Minh): v2 is the fix for the 2025-04-14 UAT deadlock (#case-silverpine-cayman-iv, Chat #L42). One idea: the Chapter 4 / CRS election belongs to exactly one role, PRIMARY_TAX_COLLABORATOR = the Designated Tax Signatory in Annex B (sub agreement Section 4.3(b)). Co-signers read and attest; they never elect. Reuse for any joint-signer W-8BEN-E flow by changing parameters only.

parameters._comment: ruleEvaluationState is the core of the fix. v1 evaluated visibleWhen/requiredWhen against each collaborator's DRAFT, so two signers could see two different forms. Never set DRAFT on a joint account.

fields.label: Designated Tax Signatory (Annex B, para 2)

validation.message: Annex B must mark exactly one Designated Tax Signatory.

fields._comment: This signer is bound to PRIMARY_TAX_COLLABORATOR for Step 4. v1 had no such field: every signer could edit tax.*.

fields.label: Chapter 4 status (W-8BEN-E Part I, line 5)
fields._comment: Co-signers see the committed value only. Their drafts of this field are discarded, never merged.

fields.label: Passive NFFE (Part XXVI): line 40b no substantial U.S. owners / line 40c owners listed in Part XXIX
Part XXIX: Substantial U.S. Owners of Passive NFFE

validation.message: Line 40c is checked: list at least one substantial U.S. owner.

fields._comment: THE BUG: v1 keyed this on draft.tax.ch4_status. Co-signer's draft still said PASSIVE_NFFE after the primary picked ACTIVE_NFFE, so Part XXIX stayed required and open for the co-signer while Step 4 waited on it.

fields.label: I have reviewed the Tax Certifications and have no authority to amend them (Annex B, para 3)
fields._comment: Each co-signer signs this, never W-8BEN-E Part XXX.

rules.then: complete = valid(committed.tax.*) && valid(committed.crs.*) && all(co_signers, c.attestation == true)
rules._comment: Releases v1 rule step4.exclusive_lock (Step 4 locked while ANY collaborator had a Step 4 section open). An open co-signer view no longer blocks anything.
Co-signer state is re-derived from the committed primary election on every commit.

rules.then: warn('FATCA and CRS classifications differ; confirm with the Administrator')
rules._comment: Warning only. The two regimes can legitimately disagree.

signvault.preflight: all(anchors, count(anchors, b.anchor == a.anchor) == 1) && count(anchors, a.recipient == 'PRIMARY_TAX_COLLABORATOR') == 1
signvault._comment: v1 put \ch4_sig\ on every signer, so our envelope pre-flight rejected the duplicate anchor. One anchor per recipient, always.
